Final for Publication

23170T1

SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
5482 South Ridgewood Court
From RT-4 to RM-4.5

The Property

The subject property is situated in a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District on the west
side of South Ridgewood Court. It is located in a Transit Served Location approximately 230.0 feet from the CTA
55” Street Bus (Route 55) Corridor.

The property is improved with a two-story single family home (approx. 27’-1” height) with no parking. The
property includes a two story rear addition.

The Project
Nabil M. Abou Baker and Sara G. Jelinek (the “Applicants”) seek to replace the two-story rear addition at the
same location. The height of the building will remain and no parking will be provided.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicants seek to rezone the property from an RT-4, Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to an RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

As part of the rezoning application, the Applicants also seek all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code, through a Type-1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) for the attached plans and also including: 1)
an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front yard setback per section 17-2-0305 to 3.96'
(existing); 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the north and south side setbacks per
section 17-2-0309 to zero (existing); 3) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the combined
side setbacks per section 17-2-0309 from 5.0’ to zero (existing); 4) an optional variation under section 17-13-
1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback per section 17-2-0306 to zero; and 5) an optional variation under sections
17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-K to reduce the rear yard open space per section 17-2-0307 to zero.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 1,913 square feet

FAR: 1.57

Floor Area: 2,995 square feet

Height: 27°-1” (existing)

Automobile Parking: zero (existing)

Rear Yard Open Space: zero*

Setbacks (existing): Front (East/Ridgewood): 3.96’ *
North: zero *
South: zero *

Rear (West): zero *

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
